items.title: 否定词的位置与部分否定
items.brief: not 紧邻量化词是部分否定，none 才是全部否定

concept.summary: 全部否定由 no、none、neither、nobody、nothing、never 这些本身含否定的词承担；部分否定则把 not 放在 all、both、every、each、always 之前，意为“并非都”。判定方法只有一条：看 not 与量化词的相对位置——not 紧邻量化词时否定的是范围，得到部分否定；否定词本身就是 none/neither 时才是全部否定。

sections.p: not 紧跟第一个操作词，位置由句法决定，不能随语义移动。要否定非谓语或某个成分时，not 直接放在该成分之前。
bullets: 否定谓语：He has not finished. / They did not come. / She is not ready.
否定非谓语：He asked me not to smoke. / Not knowing what to say, she kept silent.
否定主语或状语：Not everyone agreed. / Not surprisingly, he refused.
no + 名词 = not any + 名词：I have no time. = I don't have any time.

sections.h: 部分否定与全部否定的对照
sections.p: 同一个量化词，前面加 not 是部分否定，换成 none/neither 是全部否定。两者的谓语形式也不同：none of 接单复数皆可，neither of 接单数。
bullets: Not all birds can fly.（并非所有鸟都会飞）↔ None of the birds can fly.（全都不会）
Not both of them agreed.（并非两个都同意）↔ Neither of them agreed.（两个都不同意）
Not every student passed.（并非每个都及格）↔ No student passed.（全都不及格）
not always / not necessarily 也是部分否定：He is not always right.
none 用于三者及以上，两者用 neither：× none of the two

sections.p: 把 not 放在谓语上、量化词留在原位时，句子会被读成全部否定，与想表达的部分否定相反。写作中要让否定词与量化词相邻，才能锁定范围。
bullets: 想表部分否定：Not all the answers are correct.
易被误读：All the answers are not correct.（可理解为“全都不对”）
both 的同类问题：Both of them are not teachers. → Not both of them are teachers.
not...because 有两种读法，需靠语序或强调句消除：It was not because he was ill that he left.

examples.en: Not every suggestion was practical.
examples.zh: 并非每条建议都可行。
examples.note: not 紧邻 every，否定的是范围，属部分否定。

examples.en: None of the three candidates had the required experience.
examples.zh: 三位候选人都不具备所要求的经验。
examples.note: none 本身含否定，用于三者及以上，构成全部否定。

examples.en: None of the two candidates had the required experience.
examples.zh: 两位候选人都不具备所要求的经验。
examples.note: none 只用于三者及以上，两者须用 neither。

examples.en: Not all of the money was spent on equipment.
examples.zh: 这笔钱并非全部花在设备上。
examples.note: not all of + 不可数名词，谓语用单数 was。

examples.en: Not all of the students didn't finish the test.
examples.zh: 并非所有学生都没完成测验。
examples.note: 部分否定只需一个 not，再加 didn't 构成双重否定，语义反转。

examples.en: Neither of the twins likes spicy food.
examples.zh: 这对双胞胎都不喜欢辣的食物。
examples.note: neither 表两者全部否定，作主语谓语用单数 likes。

examples.en: Every student didn't pass the exam.
examples.zh: 并非每个学生都通过了考试。
examples.note: not 落在谓语上会被读成“每个学生都没通过”，表部分否定须写 Not every student passed the exam.

examples.en: He is not always as patient as he looks.
examples.zh: 他并不总是像看上去那么有耐心。
examples.note: not 修饰 always，属部分否定，意为“有时不是”。

pitfalls.wrong: None of the two roads leads to the village.
pitfalls.right: Neither of the two roads leads to the village.
pitfalls.why: none 指三者及以上，两者全部否定必须用 neither。

pitfalls.wrong: All the students don't want to postpone the exam.
pitfalls.right: Not all the students want to postpone the exam.
pitfalls.why: not 放在句末否定整个谓语，会被读成全部否定；表“并非都”须把 not 提到 all 之前。

pitfalls.wrong: Not everyone don't know the answer.
pitfalls.why: not 与 don't 在同一分句内叠加构成双重否定，语义反转，且与部分否定的意图相反。

contrast.diff: 部分否定否定的是数量范围（all/both/every），not 留在量化词旁；否定转移把 not 从从句提到主句谓语，语义仍落在从句。

concept.mnemonic: not 挨着 all/both/every 才是“并非都”；none/neither 才是“全都不”。

core: 全部否定：none / neither / nobody / nothing / never / no + 名词
部分否定：not all / not both / not every / not always
not 的位置决定否定范围，写作时让 not 紧邻量化词
none 用于三者及以上，两者用 neither
not 与 don't 不能在同一分句叠加
review.trigger: 看到 all/both/every 与 not 同句 → 先看两者是否相邻 → 不相邻就调整位置以免误读

quickCheck.q: none of the two 为什么错？
quickCheck.a: none 用于三者及以上，两者须用 neither。

drills.stem: ___ of the two proposals was accepted, so the project was shelved.
drills.explain: 两者全部否定用 neither，作主语时谓语用单数 was；后文“项目被搁置”说明两个都没通过。
drills.trap: None 只用于三者及以上；No one 只能指人，不能指 proposal。

drills.stem: ___ all the seats were taken; a few were still free at the back.
drills.hint: 后半句说还有几个空位。
drills.explain: 后半句“还有几个空位”说明只是部分被占，须用 not all 构成部分否定；Not all the seats were taken.

drills.stem: None of the two witnesses could identify the driver.
drills.answer: Neither of the two witnesses could identify the driver.
accept: Neither of the two witnesses could identify the driver.
drills.explain: two witnesses 明确是两者，全部否定须用 neither，谓语仍用单数 could；none 只用于三者及以上。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Not every member of the committee supported the proposal.
drills.explain: not 紧邻 every member，构成部分否定“并非每位委员都支持”，谓语用单数 supported。

drills.stem: 并非所有的学生都通过了考试。
drills.answer: Not all the students passed the exam.
drills.explain: 部分否定须把 not 提到 all 之前；若用 none 则变成全部否定，与“并非所有”意思相反。

drills.stem: ___ the questions were difficult, but the last one was almost impossible.
drills.explain: but 转折说明前面的题目并非全都难，只有最后一道极难，须用 not all 构成部分否定。
drills.trap: None 是全部否定，与 but 后的“最后一道极难”形成矛盾：若全都不难，就不会有极难的一题。

items.title: 否定转移
items.brief: think/believe 类动词的 not 前移到主句

concept.summary: 否定转移指语义上否定的是宾语从句，形式上却把 not 放在主句谓语前。适用范围限于表示看法与推测的动词：think, believe, suppose, expect, imagine（reckon, feel 同类），主语多为 I 或 we。判定方法是把 not 移回从句，若句意不变即为否定转移；hope、be afraid 等不转移。

sections.p: 三个条件同时满足才发生转移：动词表看法或推测、主语是第一人称、从句是 that 引导的陈述性内容。缺一条就按普通否定处理。
bullets: 可以转移：think, believe, suppose, expect, imagine, reckon, feel
主语多为 I / we：I don't think he knew the answer.
不能转移：hope, be afraid, fear, guess（英式）
从句含 must、need 时通常不移：I think he needn't go.

sections.p: 转移与否可以互换，但语气不同：not 提前的写法更委婉、更常见；留在从句里语气更直接、更强调否定。写作中第一人称多用转移形式。
bullets: I don't think she will agree. = I think she will not agree.
I don't believe he has finished. = I believe he has not finished.
委婉请求：I don't suppose you could help me?
与部分否定叠加：I don't think all of them will come.（我认为不是所有人都会来）

sections.h: 附加问句与不能转移的情形
sections.p: 发生转移后，主句形式上是否定，但语义否定在从句，因此附加问句要与从句的主语和谓语一致，并用肯定形式。这一点是考试中的固定考点。
bullets: I don't think he is right, is he?（与从句 he is 一致，用肯定）
She doesn't expect the talks to resume, does she?
hope 不移：× I don't hope it rains. → I hope it doesn't rain.
be afraid 不移：× I am not afraid he will fail.（此句意为“我不怕他失败”，语义已改变）
简答固定说法：I hope not. / I'm afraid not.

examples.en: I don't think the plan will work without more funding.
examples.zh: 我认为没有更多资金这个计划行不通。
examples.note: 语义否定的是从句 will work，not 前移到 think 之前。

examples.en: I think the plan will not work without more funding.
examples.zh: 我认为没有更多资金这个计划行不通。
examples.note: 不转移的等义表达，否定留在从句，语气更直接。

examples.en: I don't hope it rains tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我希望明天不要下雨。
examples.note: hope 不参与否定转移，应说 I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow.

examples.en: I don't suppose you have a spare pen, do you?
examples.zh: 你身上没有多余的笔吧？
examples.note: 否定转移 + 委婉请求，附加问句与从句一致且用肯定形式。

examples.en: She doesn't expect the talks to resume before June.
examples.zh: 她预计谈判不会在六月前恢复。
examples.note: expect 属可转移动词，语义否定的是 to resume。

examples.en: I don't think he is right, doesn't he?
examples.zh: 我认为他不对，是吗？
examples.note: 主句已是否定形式，附加问句须用肯定，且与从句主语一致，应为 is he?

examples.en: I don't imagine anyone will object to the change.
examples.zh: 我想不会有人反对这项变动。
examples.note: imagine 属可转移动词，否定落在从句 anyone will object 上。

examples.en: I think not he will come to the party.
examples.zh: 我认为他不会来参加聚会。
examples.note: not 不能直接放在从句主语前，应改为 I don't think he will come 或 I think he won't come.

pitfalls.wrong: I don't hope you mind the noise.
pitfalls.right: I hope you don't mind the noise.
pitfalls.why: hope 不参与否定转移，not 必须留在宾语从句中。

pitfalls.wrong: I don't think he is qualified, isn't he?
pitfalls.right: I don't think he is qualified, is he?
pitfalls.why: 否定转移后主句形式为否定，附加问句取肯定形式，并与从句的主语、谓语一致。

pitfalls.wrong: I am not believing he is honest.
pitfalls.right: I don't believe he is honest.
pitfalls.why: believe 表“认为”时不用进行时，否定由 don't 承担并前移到主句。

contrast.withTitle: 否定词的位置与部分否定
contrast.diff: 否定转移是 not 从从句移到主句谓语，语义仍指向从句；部分否定是 not 修饰量化词，语义指向数量范围。

concept.mnemonic: 想、信、猜、料、想象，not 往前站；hope 和 afraid 原地不动。

core: 可转移动词：think, believe, suppose, expect, imagine, reckon, feel
主语多为第一人称，从句为 that 引导的陈述内容
hope、be afraid 不转移，not 留在从句
转移后附加问句用肯定形式，并与从句一致：..., is he?
简答固定说法：I hope not. / I'm afraid not.
review.trigger: 看到 I don't think/believe/suppose + 从句 → 语义否定在从句 → 附加问句按从句写肯定

quickCheck.q: “我认为他不会来”最常用的说法？
quickCheck.a: I don't think he will come.

quickCheck.q: I don't hope it rains. 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: hope 不转移，应说 I hope it doesn't rain.

quickCheck.q: I don't think she knows, ___? 填什么？
quickCheck.a: does she，与从句一致且用肯定形式。

drills.stem: I ___ think the committee has reached a final decision yet.
drills.explain: 主句谓语是实义动词 think，否定须借 don't 构成，语义上否定的是从句 has reached。
drills.trap: not 不能单独作谓语否定，必须依附于操作词；haven't 与 think 的时态和结构都不匹配。

drills.stem: I don't believe she ___ (be) serious about resigning.
drills.hint: 否定虽然在主句，从句仍按肯定形式写。
drills.explain: 否定转移只是把 not 前移，从句本身仍是肯定陈述，故用 is；若把 not 留在从句则写 isn't。

drills.stem: I don't hope the flight is delayed again.
drills.answer: I hope the flight isn't delayed again.
accept: I hope the flight isn't delayed again.
I hope the flight is not delayed again.
drills.explain: hope 不参与否定转移，否定必须留在宾语从句中，用 isn't 否定 is delayed。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: I don't suppose she will agree to the terms.
drills.explain: suppose 属可转移动词，not 前移到主句，从句保持肯定形式 will agree。

drills.stem: 我认为他不会接受这个提议。
drills.answer: I don't think he will accept the offer.
forbid: I think not he will accept
I don't think he will accepts
drills.explain: 第一人称 + think 构成否定转移，not 放在主句；从句用肯定形式 will accept，accept 不加 s。

drills.stem: — Do you think it will rain this afternoon? — I ___.
drills.explain: hope 的否定简答固定为 I hope not，not 直接跟在 hope 之后，不发生前移。
drills.trap: don't hope so 是把否定转移规则错误地套到 hope 上，hope 只能用 I hope not。

items.title: 双重否定与否定的词汇表达
items.brief: 两个否定相消表肯定，也可换用含否定义的词

concept.summary: 标准英语中同一分句内的两个否定相互抵消，构成肯定：not uncommon 意为 fairly common，never fail to 意为 always。但三重否定或否定词与否定副词叠加会造成语义混乱，属不规范。另一条路径是用本身含否定义的词（fail, deny, refuse, hardly, seldom, few, little, without）承担否定，避免 not 重复。

sections.p: 判断依据是两个否定是否在同一分句内修饰同一成分。若是，则相互抵消表肯定，语气比直接肯定更委婉；若叠加到三重或与否定副词混用，则语义失控。
bullets: 相消表肯定（书面、保守）：not uncommon, not impossible, not without reason
never fail to do = always do：He never fails to write.
不规范的双重否定：× I don't need no help. → I don't need any help.
否定词 + 否定副词要避免：× He doesn't hardly work. → He hardly works.

sections.p: 这些词本身含否定意义，句子整体视为否定句，因此附加问句用肯定形式，且不能再加 not。它们在句中的位置与普通副词相同。
bullets: hardly, scarcely, barely, seldom, rarely, never
few 表“几乎没有”（否定），a few 表“一些”（肯定）；little 与 a little 同理
He hardly ever calls, does he?（附加问句用肯定）
× He hardly has time, hasn't he?

sections.p: 写作中把 not + 动词换成含否定义的词，可以让句子更紧凑，也避免否定堆叠。但替换前须核对语义是否等值：refuse 含“拒绝”的意愿义，不能随意替换 didn't do。
bullets: 否定前缀：un-, in-/im-/il-/ir-, dis-, non-, mis-；后缀：-less
否定动词：fail to, refuse to, deny, avoid, lack
否定介词短语：without, instead of, far from, free from
转换示例：He didn't pass the exam. → He failed the exam. / The package arrived without any damage.

examples.en: The results are not uncommon in coastal areas.
examples.zh: 这种结果在沿海地区并不罕见。
examples.note: not + uncommon 两个否定相消，意为 fairly common，语气比直接说 common 委婉。

examples.en: He never fails to send his mother a card on her birthday.
examples.zh: 他从不会忘记在母亲生日时寄一张卡片。
examples.note: never + fail 构成双重否定，等于 always remembers。

examples.en: I don't need no advice from someone who has never done the job.
examples.zh: 我不需要一个从没做过这工作的人给建议。
examples.note: 两个否定在同一分句内不规范，应改为 I don't need any advice。

examples.en: She hardly ever complains about the workload.
examples.zh: 她几乎从不抱怨工作量。
examples.note: hardly 是半否定词，句子整体为否定意义。

examples.en: She hardly ever complains, doesn't she?
examples.zh: 她几乎从不抱怨，是吗？
examples.note: 含半否定词的句子按否定句处理，附加问句须用肯定形式 does she。

examples.en: Few of the students had read the article before the seminar.
examples.zh: 讨论课前几乎没有学生读过那篇文章。
examples.note: few 表“几乎没有”，是否定意义，与 a few 相反。

examples.en: The package arrived without any damage.
examples.zh: 包裹送到时完好无损。
examples.note: without 承担否定意义，句中不再需要 not。

examples.en: He failed to not attend the meeting.
examples.zh: 他没能不出席会议。
examples.note: fail to 已含否定，再加 not 造成双重否定且语义混乱，应直接说 He attended the meeting.

pitfalls.wrong: I don't have no idea what he means.
pitfalls.right: I don't have any idea what he means.
pitfalls.why: 标准英语一个分句只允许一个否定词，no 与 don't 重复，须把 no 换成 any。

pitfalls.wrong: He hardly has time to breathe, hasn't he?
pitfalls.right: He hardly has time to breathe, has he?
pitfalls.why: hardly 使句子成为否定句，附加问句必须用肯定形式。

pitfalls.wrong: He denied that he had not seen the document.
pitfalls.right: He denied that he had seen the document.
pitfalls.why: deny 已含否定，从句再加 not 会使语义变成“他否认自己没看见”，与原意相反。

contrast.withTitle: 否定词的位置与部分否定
contrast.diff: 双重否定在同一分句内叠加两个否定、结果表肯定；部分否定只有一个 not，作用在 all/both/every 上，结果表“并非全部”。

concept.mnemonic: 一个分句一个否定；两个否定相消表肯定；hardly 已是否定，后面别再加 not。

core: 同一分句两个否定相消表肯定：not uncommon = fairly common
标准英语一个分句只用一个否定词，× don't need no
半否定词 hardly/seldom/rarely/few/little 视为否定，附加问句用肯定
few 表几乎没有，a few 表一些
词汇否定：fail to / deny / without / 否定前缀与后缀
review.trigger: 看到句中出现两个否定词 → 先判断是否同一分句 → 同一分句就去掉一个或换成 any

quickCheck.a: does he，半否定句的附加问句用肯定。

quickCheck.q: I don't need no help. 怎么改？

drills.stem: The task is not ___ for a beginner, but it does take patience.
drills.explain: not + impossible 两个否定相消，意为“并非不可能”，与 but 从句的让步语气一致。
drills.trap: possible 会构成“并非可能”，即“不可能”，与后文“但确实需要耐心”的转折矛盾；unpossible 不是英语词。

drills.stem: She ___ ever eats meat; she has been a vegetarian for years.
drills.hint: 需要一个表“几乎不”的半否定副词。
drills.explain: hardly ever 意为“几乎从不”，是半否定表达，与后半句“多年素食”一致；此处不能再用 not。

drills.stem: I don't need no help with the luggage.
drills.answer: I don't need any help with the luggage.
accept: I don't need any help with the luggage.
drills.explain: don't 与 no 在同一分句内构成不规范的双重否定，须把 no 换成 any，只保留一个否定词。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He never fails to reply to emails.
drills.explain: never 与 fail to 构成双重否定，整体表肯定“他总是回复邮件”，谓语用第三人称单数 fails。

drills.stem: 他几乎不抱怨工作负担。
drills.answer: He hardly ever complains about his workload.
drills.explain: hardly ever 已是半否定，谓语用肯定形式 complains；再加 doesn't 会形成双重否定且不合规范。

drills.stem: There is ___ point in arguing; the decision has been made.
drills.explain: point 在此不可数，little 表“几乎没有”，与“决定已经作出”的语境一致，构成否定意义。
drills.trap: a little 表“有一些”，会得出“争论还有点意义”的相反结论；few 与 a few 只能修饰可数名词复数。
